extensionDescription.message: A clean new tab with a responsive bookmark grid, crisp icons, drag sorting, and automatic light and dark themes.

syncRecover.message: Restore websites and icons from cloud

syncEmptyGuard.message: Empty configuration blocked. Use Restore websites and icons from cloud.

syncNoRecovery.message: Neither the cloud version nor its retained previous version contains websites. Restore a file version from your cloud provider.

noAppStoreIcon.message: No matching App Store app was found.

privacyNotice.message: The configured interface is called only when selected. Change it in extension settings.

openFailed.message: Could not open this address. Check the URL in your bookmarks.

orderFailed.message: Could not save the order. Please try again.

missingFolder.message: Create a “New tab” folder in Chrome bookmarks and add websites to it.

emptyFolder.message: In the browser bookmark manager, add websites to Other bookmarks → Yiu’s tab. You can move or rename the folder; keep its ID bookmark.

bookmarksFailed.message: Could not read bookmarks. Open a new tab and try again.

fetchFailed.message: Could not load the icon. Please try again later.

noThirdPartyIcon.message: No high-resolution icon was found by the third-party source.

saveFailed.message: Could not save changes. Please try again.

extensionOnly.message: Load this folder as a Chrome extension, then open a new tab.

emptyResponse.message: The server returned an empty response.

imageTooLarge.message: Images must be {max} MB or smaller.

imageTimeout.message: The image took too long to load.

imageUnreadable.message: This image could not be read.

eyedropper.message: Pick a color from the screen

backupHint.message: Back up bookmarks, order, icon appearance, color and opacity, scale, image position, sources, and local images in a restorable JSON file.

backupPrivacy.message: Backups contain URLs and images. Keep them private. Cloud passwords are excluded. Maximum: 64 MB.

importHint.message: Match bookmarks in New tab by URL, add missing sites, and apply the saved icon settings and order. Other bookmarks are kept.

readyToImport.message: Review the import, then apply it.

imported.message: Configuration applied. Open new tab pages will refresh.

invalidBackup.message: Invalid configuration file or incomplete image data.

backupTooLarge.message: Configuration files must be smaller than 64 MB.

invalidTemplate.message: Use an HTTP(S) interface with a domain or URL placeholder.

invalidCloudURL.message: Enter the full HTTPS cloud file URL without embedded credentials.

cloudHint.message: Enter the server URL, username, and app password supplied by your provider. Sync configuration and icons automatically when enabled.

rememberSecret.message: Save username and app password on this device

cloudPrivacy.message: When enabled, URLs, configuration, and icons are sent to the address above. Account credentials stay on this device and are not synced.

allowOverwrite.message: Allow this upload to replace the cloud configuration file

overwriteRequired.message: Allow replacing the cloud file before uploading.

edgeHint.message: An extension in Chrome cannot use Edge account sync. Browser sync and image backups are separate; this interface works independently of the browser.

presetSelected.message: Interface filled in. Save settings to apply it.

thirdPartyHint.message: Website icons remain the first choice. This interface is called only when you select the third-party source for an individual icon.

templateHint.message: Placeholders: {domain} (hostname), {url} (full URL), {size} (256). Values are URL-encoded. The interface must return an image.

providerHint.message: For mainland China, consider Favicon.org.cn (a free key is available on its site). Favicon.im requires no key. Availability and free quotas depend on the provider.

fixFields.message: Check the highlighted fields. Changes are saved automatically.

syncEnable.message: Enable automatic sync (save app credentials on this device)

syncConflictHint.message: The same item changed on two devices. Other changes are preserved. Choose which values to keep for conflicts.

syncComplete.message: Configuration and icons are up to date

syncPending.message: Changes saved locally; waiting to sync

syncOffline.message: Network unavailable. Local changes are kept and will retry automatically.

syncAuth.message: Authentication or access failed. Check the account and app password.

syncUnsupported.message: Cloud version checks failed (ETag or conditional writes). Local settings are retained.

syncFolder.message: Cannot create the icon directory. Make sure the parent folder exists and is writable.

syncInvalidData.message: Cloud data is incompatible or failed image verification. The original file will not be overwritten.

syncTooLarge.message: Configuration or images exceed the sync size limit.

syncRemember.message: Background sync needs credentials saved on this device.

syncHTTP.message: The cloud service could not complete the request. Retrying automatically.

syncAsset.message: Some icons could not be downloaded. Local configuration is unchanged; retrying automatically.

syncBusy.message: Cloud maintenance is running. Retrying shortly.

syncRace.message: Another device just updated the cloud. Checking and merging again.

syncLocalChanged.message: New changes are being saved. Syncing shortly.

syncFailed.message: Sync is incomplete. Local changes are preserved.

syncPreview.message: This preview does not connect to the cloud. Configure sync in the extension.

syncFormat.message: The cloud file uses an incompatible format. Choose a new empty configuration file URL; the original file is preserved.

noticeLocalRetry.message: Local settings are kept. Retrying automatically.

noticeUsingLocal.message: Using local settings. Check sync in settings.

syncNetworkFailure.message: Cannot reach the cloud service. Local changes are kept; retrying automatically.

shortcutCanvas.message: Click empty space to open settings

shortcutIcon.message: Click a website icon to edit its appearance

syncDeleteGuard.message: This round would delete {count} items, above the {limit}-item safety limit.

syncRemoteMissing.message: The cloud change log is unexpectedly missing. Local deletion was blocked.

syncIncompleteListing.message: The cloud PROPFIND response was empty or incomplete. Sync was stopped.

syncRemoteReset.message: The cloud change log was reset or shortened. Local data was protected.
